producer_report.summary: I wrote an independent review of the study capability M1 design at docs/design/reviews/study-capability-m1-review-1.md. It answers the eight §9 checks in order, each with a verdict and citations to design sections and BRIEF.md lines. There are 13 findings, each with a severity: 6 major, 5 minor, 2 nit, and no blocker. The review's overall verdict is "revise before build", so the design may not proceed to build yet. The major findings are: containment is not added although athena-v0 §16.2 says the first job that runs third-party code must pull it in (F1); secrets, redaction and the studied system's own spend are not handled (F2); lab requirements from BRIEF S3 are missing from the method (F3); the waiver path can disable any rule, and `both` claims are not constrained (F4); five of the 14 validation rules need judgment as written (F5); and the model cannot express multi-agent, human-in-the-loop or non-returning-retry shapes (F6). Checks 2 (no claim about firstmate) and 8 (scope) pass. I did not otherwise edit the design. I added a status pointer line to it and an "Added" entry to CHANGELOG.md.

open_issues: The six major findings (F1 to F6) must be answered by a later job. The review recommends a short second review that rechecks F1 to F6 only.
Check 8 (only the design was added) was not verified against the diff that added the design. The review notes that whoever lands it should run git show --stat on that commit.
I did not run clippy or test, since no Rust files changed.
mistakes: My first draft of the review said 'four major findings' while listing six. I corrected the text and removed a confusing counting paragraph.
learnings: The design's pointer in §8 says CHANGELOG.md is out of scope for the design's own change. This review job's CHANGELOG entry does not conflict with that.
athena-v0 §16.2 and §14 say containment is pulled in by the first job that runs code not written by Athena's agents. The study's run step is that job.
The working copy is a one-commit snapshot, so 'only the design was added' could only be checked against the current tree (no crates/ directory, no 'study' in docs/architecture.md).
